turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Mr. Hale. I have about twenty minutes. Withdraw the zero.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
I didn't come for pleasantries. Is the zero still in the gradebook, yes or no?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells it says not to use it as the sole basis for punishing a student. What else do you have, Hale?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.
"Quite reliable." Okay. Your own school's procedure, section 4.3, says software results don't establish a concern by themselves, so I'll ask again: what else do you have?
So I had to give him a zero.
"Had to." Section 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in, and nobody did. Owen saw that zero on his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided, and was Owen heard first?
I hope you understand my position.
"I hope you understand." Okay. I asked who decided and whether Owen was heard first, and I'm still waiting for an answer.
